channel.title: Yii Framework | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: Yii: XML generator
item.description: As I needed to create some custom XMLs for a project I am working on, I have created an Yii extension based on a nice class being developed by Simon Willison. Using this extension, everyone will be easily able to generate an XML. I am pretty sure there may be different and even more powerful …

item.title: Waiting for ‘The Yii Book’
item.description: It’s about a month ago that I came to know that Larry Ullman, a web programmer and writer of wonderful tutorials/books, was about to write a new book on the Yii framework, my favourite PHP framework at all.
